midas.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: definitive Balatro Joker game sprite. Reference image is a contact sheet of this project's actual vanilla and custom cards; use it ONLY as style reference. Create ONE complete portrait playing card, straight-on, full uncropped rounded rectangle, aspect ratio 71:95. Intentionally coarse low-resolution pixel art, as if hand drawn on a 71 by 95 pixel grid and enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Hard chunky pixels, small restricted palette, simple silhouette, grotesque funny strange expressive, slightly dirty aged cream card border with red thin inner frame. Minimalist clear iconography readable when reduced to 71x95. No painterly texture, no realism, no 3D, no smooth modern illustration, no cute face. No words, names, stats, numbers, labels, watermark; optional small normal vertical JOKER lettering on edge only if unobtrusive. Transparent outside the opaque card; keep card large filling image. Each design must have its own composition. MIDAS: fuse avaricious Greed and Golden Joker into an original gold-transformed angular jester king, smug toothy grin, golden fingers melting into a short heap of oversized gold coins, three-quarter head tilted proudly upward. Burgundy and nearly black backdrop, metallic flat ochre highlights, exaggerated hooked nose. NOT the repeated sad red-hatted seated jester in the reference. One unified character, not two cards next to each other.
Revision: Edit ONLY the border and side lettering of this MIDAS Joker card to designate a FUSION Joker. Preserve the central jester and gold coins composition exactly, no redraw of character. Replace the ordinary cream outer frame with a distinctive muted antique-GOLD and deep RED double frame, chunky pixel stepped corners, slightly worn, NOT ornate or 3D. Leave narrow cream side typographic strips; add conventional J O K E R letters vertically at upper left and rotated 180 degrees at lower right, dark burgundy fill and a THIN GOLD pixel outline around each individual letter. This delicate gold outline must be visible at small size. Gold/red outer frame is the main differentiator, still compatible with the aged retro pixel card. No other text, labels or stats. Keep portrait71:95, transparent exterior. May uniformly shrink central art a little to make space for side letters, no stretching.
